description: This file is a Java test class for the HiveMqtt3ClientActor, which tests MQTT client behavior using the HiveMQ MQTT library within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes tests for connection management, message subscription, and message handling with mock components.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ClientActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the HiveMqtt3ClientActor's MQTT connection and messaging behavior, utilizing mock HiveMQ client factory and Akka TestKit.

methods.name: initClient
methods.description: Initializes the MQTT client before each test, mocking the Mqtt3Client and setting up the mock client factory.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect has been called on the mock client factory.

methods.name: testSubscribeFails
methods.description: Tests the behavior when subscribing to a topic fails, expecting a failure message and then a successful disconnect.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates props for the MQTT client actor with a mock client factory for normal operation.

methods.name: createFailingClientActor
methods.description: Creates props for the MQTT client actor that simulates connection failure.

methods.name: createClientActorWithMessages
methods.description: Creates props for the MQTT client from a list of messages, to simulate message receipt.

methods.name: mqttMessage
methods.description: Constructs an MQTT publish message with specified topic and payload.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts and decodes the payload from an MQTT message.

methods.name: extractTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic string from an MQTT message.

methods.name: getMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the class type for MQTT publish messages.
